objective: statesNamedIn reports 'West Virginia' as two states, so every West Virginia or Washington DC question is refused as naming two jurisdictions. server/domain/jurisdiction.ts ~L130 tests each state name independently with \b boundaries, so 'Coal permits in West Virginia counties' returns ['virginia','west virginia'] and 'Recording fees in Washington, DC' returns ['washington','district of columbia']; russell/compiler.ts refuses on two results (CLAUDE.md §25). Fix: scan names longest-first and blank out each matched span before testing shorter names; treat 'Washington, DC' and 'Washington D.C.' as the district only; leave the ', OH' capitals rule untouched.
expectedOutcome: Overlapping state names resolve to the one jurisdiction the text names.
nonGoals: Adding any state list beyond what exists

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/jurisdictionOverlappingNames.test.ts: 'Coal permits in West Virginia counties' returns ['west virginia'], while 'Virginia and West Virginia' returns both.
'Recording fees in Washington, DC' returns ['district of columbia'] and 'Washington state' still returns washington.
Existing jurisdiction and compiler tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
